answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 15 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in sparrow, verified in vine, and ocean names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 60 dollars and 2 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
